Motivation comes from an insatiable curiosity and love for growth. Even after years, the desire to explore new techniques and express deeper emotions keeps the flame alive, reminding me that mastery is an endless journey.
Can you share a turning point when you realized your work could inspire others?

What do you believe sets a virtuoso apart from other talented artists?

How do you handle creative blocks or moments of self-doubt in your practice?

Creative blocks are inevitable, but I view them as opportunities to pause and reflect. I immerse myself in other art forms or nature, allowing inspiration to rekindle naturally rather than forcing it, which often leads to richer, more authentic expression.
